svg.text: Legacy Seal — The wax seal on a signed will: the family inside a sealed plan. (1 Glow · 2 Line · 3 Solid stacked)
Guardian Arch — A home doorway that shelters four generations: estate + guardianship. (1 Glow · 2 Line · 3 Solid stacked)
Family Crest — A family crest: "Let our family protect your family," and her family name. (1 Glow · 2 Line · 3 Solid stacked)
Legacy Key — The key to the family home, handed down. (1 Glow · 2 Line · 3 Solid stacked)
Quill Pen — The pen that writes the will and the plan. (1 Glow · 2 Line · 3 Solid stacked)
Sheltering Hands — Two hands that cradle the family: guardianship + elder care. (1 Glow · 2 Line · 3 Solid stacked)
